scheme_name: Aushadhi Avam Sugandhit Fasal Shetra Vistar
other_conditions: Applicable for all sections of farmers
Farmers who have obtained forest rights certificates are eligible
Grant is payable only once to a farmer
Grant is payable for a minimum of 0.25 hectare and a maximum of 2.00 hectare
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 20‑50% (₹5,000–₹62,500 per hectare) for the cultivation of medicinal and aromatic crops.
